name: Mimic / Mimic: Sigil of Malice / Mimic: Distortion / Mimic: Ethereal Chains

values.meaning: Orb Magic Damage (Mimic: Sigil of Malice)
Mark Magic Damage (Mimic: Sigil of Malice)

mechanics.claim: Mimic recasts LeBlanc's most recently used basic ability (Q/W/E) with modified damage numbers, applying the same effects as the original ability.
mechanics.quote: '''LeBlanc''' casts a mimicked version of her most recently used basic ability, applying the same effects and dealing {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: In the Sigil of Malice mimic, the orb hit deals the orb damage, and if it consumes an existing Sigil of Malice mark on the target, the mark consumption deals double that amount as a separate instance.
mechanics.quote: The orb deals modified damage, while the mark consumption deals double that amount.

mechanics.claim: In the Ethereal Chains mimic, the tether's initial application deals the application damage, and if the tether fractures (target fails to break it), the fracture deals double that amount as a separate instance.
mechanics.quote: The tether's application deals modified damage, while its fracturing deals double that amount.

mechanics.claim: If Mimic is ranked up before LeBlanc has cast any basic ability, it defaults to Mimic: Sigil of Malice.
mechanics.quote: ''Mimic'' will default to {{ai|Mimic: Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}} if ''LeBlanc'' ranks up ''Mimic'' without having used any abilities beforehand (even if she has not yet learned {{ai|Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}}).

mechanics.claim: Both Mimic: Ethereal Chains and Mimic: Sigil of Malice apply their secondary (double) damage instance if the original ability's condition for that secondary damage is met, matching the original ability's mechanic.
mechanics.quote: Both {{ai|Mimic: Ethereal Chains|LeBlanc}} and {{ai|Mimic: Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}} will apply damage twice if the original ability's condition to do so is met.
